title: A bit on the thin side
text: A bit on the thin side. I purchased this to encase a 20x72 inch Acanva Fluffy Bed Sleeping Side Sleeper Body Pillow Insert. This cover is thin and requires a lot of care to enclose the pillow. Too much force and you can easily tear the opening that has a flimsy zipper.  The zipper is stitched in, but I am not sure (or confident) with how strong the stitches are. At any rate, I did manage to stuff the pillow inside, so all is well. And I am not sure that any cover for a 20x72 inch pillow is going to be easy to get the pillow inside. In retrospect I should have just ordered the pillow without this cover (or any cover) and been done with it. But this cover does deserve some credit for being able to encase a behemoth pillow, and I am not sure that any cover designed by any company is going to be fun to install.
